questions.question:
Find the number of rectangles in the given figure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6d04487a9ebd9442b6f0fb1109f2a676d76d4ec8981fed12eb4baf2507e52f2d.png]
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/efb90c3647c276e117dc17fb6439410dad00fafe8f511a89c38f32cba7de65df.png] 

**__Rectangle__:** A rectangle is a*** four-sided figure*** or shape and ***all angles should be right angle.***

**__Square__:** A square, there are** *4 sides*** and ***all the four angles are right angles.***

**__Right Angle__*: ***A right angle is ***an angle of exactly 90°***, The angle bounded by*** two lines perpendicular*** to each other.

***A square is a special type of rectangle because it possesses all the properties of a rectangle. Similar to a rectangle, a square has:***

__
 
• Opposite sides that are parallel and equal.
 
• Two diagonals that bisect each other and are equal.

Thus, a*** square*** is a ***rectangle***.

The given figure:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/79b546f1233cbdc17791cc6081208a176aca1578fa06173351272e9082bffcab.png] 

The rectangles in the figure: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, (1, 2)

Hence, **there are 6 rectangles in the figure.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

Squares are a subset of rectangles, hence, all squares are also rectangles.** **

questions.question:
How many triangles are there in the given figure?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5ba42db7f361f9fbf9670ee305e42ceaff835b27a413bc852eff13cf047d821c.png]
questions.solution:
The number of triangles in the given figure is shown below:

1) Total triangles = [Number of parts × (1 + Number of parts)] ÷ 2

= [2 × (1 + 2)] ÷ 2

= [2 × 3] ÷ 2

= 6 ÷ 2

= 3

As there are 2 same types of triangles, therefore total number of triangles will be (3 × 2) = 6 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e07a7caf553f170f4cc76c3f707202879c720bed8b606bc9d6961ded48d3ad52.png] 

2) As marked there are total 12 triangles.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/44576f71cdb8902d88190b98966d0312f0463a404e8b5b7791c9af313f1eaa3a.png] 

Thus, there are total (6 + 12) = 18 triangles.

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.

questions.question:
How many squares are there in the following figure?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e2782d89b8b854e0f7698e7cf8357f061e6e264d1f6df6eed4070a3d16effd9b.png]
questions.solution:
The number of squares in the figure is shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f9ffa754ece0929ef561208653049c7dd45f60656fac44e2e362bee49690512c.png] 

Hence, ‘33’ is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eb90b93a57024b0fb23177d488e8a4666542aad59e1e26fb456a09058f561fcb.png] 

If are 3 rows and 3 columns in the above figure. So let n = 3.

Here, we using formulas for finding the number of squares in an n × n grid as follows.

**__Formula__ :-**

**n² + (n - 1)² + (n - 2)² + - - - - - - - - - - + (n - n)²**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/747dff777a86677f127d0faab4f6d02956e937c092596c0ec0fb1410d093a96c.png] 

Now substitute n = 3 in the above formula,

3² + (3 - 1)² + (3 - 2)² + (3 - 3)²

9 + 2² + 12 + 0 = 9 + 4 + 1 =** 14**

If are 2 rows and 2 columns in the above figure. So let n = 2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/38c5cbd57b5e70d0d805a4069c5960b44e51ca4b1d00683dc392563fa9c0751a.png] 

Now substitute n = 2 in the above formula,

2² + (2 - 1)² = 4 + 1 =** 5**

Now,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ab1f5473dfac5f5a03523789218abeabc532a70be91e59c40b3bec2f88a9a612.png] 

Till now, total squares = 14 + 5 + 8 = 27

6 squares are given in detail (square no. 26, 28, 30, 31, 32, 33)

So, total number of squares = 27 + 6 =** 33.**

questions.question:
How many triangles are there in the given figure ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3a49569756adea7b4f0e86c594ca025c87e5e41556b63e6e6c16a4f71b046b7e.png]
questions.solution:
Here, we need to count total number of triangle.

First we will count all the small triangles as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a4dcaf3735e308da8bcd3b2cba961a245663d91fb655c585807a8cbf5f961b6c.png] 

So, we have 10 triangles.

Next, we will combine two or more triangles, we will have,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d4f1f2f1cebb6363bbb37111dca75a56c2667e101efeec35064640cc4a015f8f.png] 

So, triangles we have are: PQS, PQT, PQU, PRT, PRU, PSU, PVX, PVY, PVZ, PWY, PWZ, PXZ - total of 12 triangles.

Thus, we have a total of 10 + 12 = 22 triangles.

Hence, we have __**22**__ triangles.
